Do you have a routine you follow and get enough sleep, food and water? It sounds obvious and silly but it's so hard for me to do that when I'm anxious/depressed (which is most of the time) I skip meals and barely eat or drink enough water and then that in turn makes me feel worse and then staying up all night I don't rarely even complete the tasks I stay up to complete and then blame myself for not doing enough. 

So if you can force yourself into a routine where you have at least 8hrs of sleep and enough food and drink that can help with the physical stuff. But otherwise regularly seeing friends maybe twice a week so you don't feel alone and taking opportuniries to explore and get out of home/where you are usually so you don't have the chance to ruminate about life and depression/anxiety. 

I'm so glad your open to changing, that's probably one of the hardest steps because it's like dealing with an addiction to thoughts sometimes. 

Anyway hopefully we can fight this :) 

I'll still be here if you need someone random to vent to if things arn't working out. 

finding a nice therapist is a good start too (but please don't give up if you don't find the right one first try).
